parts.name: retrodiscal-loose-tissue
parts.note: Closed core trimmed at disc surface; follows exposed upper/lower lamina body, excluding the bone insertion strip.

report.method: Preserve the original attachment body. Extend only a temporary terminal strip through the condyle, perform exact surface clipping, discard generated cutter faces, and join the retained strip to the unchanged body. Contact is evaluated against the source faceted bone mesh.
limits: Estimated insertion territory, not a segmented anatomical footprint.
Bone contact is a zero-thickness display boundary; numerical intersections at contact are not classified as penetration.
Computational cavity closures still require anatomical interpretation.
